payload.teaser: Today's word comes from the story about the Breeders' Cup at Keeneland.

reveal.excerpt: The 2026 Breeders' Cup World Championships is the 43rd edition of the premier event of the North American Thoroughbred horse racing year. The 14 races, all of which are Grade I ranked, take place on October 30 and 31 at Keeneland Race Course in Lexington, Kentucky.
